$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a coastal custom builder content seed (Tideline Builders, Cannon Beach), re-registered in the tideline register with its own page skeletons. Everything structural — builders, routes, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Custom builder & contractor
description: A custom builder's site: a full-bleed title-card hero, a now-building ticker, one house's build log as photo cards on a rail, a materials board, services with honest starting figures, draggable before/after restorations, site-walk booking, and a project-inquiry form — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins).

types.name: Site walk
types.description: Ninety minutes on the lot or in the house — the ground, the view, the weather side, and what's possible.

types.name: Design consult
types.description: An hour at the studio with drawings, samples, and the species boards: scope, budget, and schedule.

theme.$comment: The tideline register's brand overlay: the preset's lamplight amber as the project brand, so app-side surfaces wear the same coastal register as the marketing pages instead of the kernel default blue. Values match the tideline preset's own light/dark accents — the marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so keeping them identical means the overlay re-brands the app without shifting the pages. mode dark opens the site in the register's native fog-slate appearance (the appearance toggle still swaps to the bright fog-morning reading). navigation pins the split letterhead (wordmark and place line left, links and the one ask right) so the full-bleed photograph owns the first screen; remixes re-pin their own.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/Services/ServicesPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match servicesLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. The preset is tideline (the coastal timber house: fog-slate ground under sea-mist grain, bone Fraunces set thin at monumental scale, hairlines, one lamplight-amber accent, full-bleed photographs that dissolve into the ground) — a custom builder that sells by the photograph and the process, deliberately apart from sitework's licensed-and-insured signage (which the derived trades templates keep: their catalogs pin sitework and their own skeletons).
